mapper.sql: account_id, seller_id, tenant_id, account_name, id_card_no, bank_card_no, bank_name, kyc_status, balance, frozen, version, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seller_account WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seller_account (seller_id, tenant_id, kyc_status, balance, frozen, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{tenantId}, #{kycStatus}, #{balance}, #{frozen}, #{version}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE seller_account SET account_name = #{accountName}, id_card_no = #{idCardNo}, bank_card_no = #{bankCardNo}, bank_name = #{bankName}, kyc_status = 'pending', update_time = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND kyc_status IN ('unverified','rejected')
UPDATE seller_account SET kyc_status = #{kycStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND kyc_status = 'pending'
UPDATE seller_account SET balance = balance + #{amount}, version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE seller_account SET frozen = #{frozen}, update_time = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}

UPDATE seller_account SET frozen = 0, unfreeze_reason = #{reason}, unfreeze_by = #{operatorId}, unfreeze_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND frozen = 1
